parameters.symbol: lowercase Paribu market id, for example btc_tl
parameters.limit: 300 verified in the recorded probes; production reader caps every request at 500
parameters.to: Unix milliseconds; the client subtracts one millisecond from an exclusive boundary

native_zero_volume_semantics: Record published directly by Paribu for a no-trade interval; no execution is inferred and no local OHLCV row is created.
local_synthetic_policy: SYNTHETIC_FFILL remains is_authentic=false and remains blocked by the existing scanner and BTC gates.
contract_limitations: The endpoint is used by Paribu's own current web chart. Its availability and schema can change. Unsupported or malformed replies fail closed; there is no claim of a documented permanent availability guarantee.
monitoring: Finite diagnostic runs only; no continuous monitor was created.
